name: Gadroon
description: One row of cast lobes standing along the bottom edge.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, #000 48%, transparent 48%) 0 0 / 25% 50%, linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, #000 48%, transparent 48%) 0 0 / 25% 50%, linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 50%, transparent 50%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
